title: Copy nodes, error index out of bounds
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in:
v4.8.dev2.official [7220d456d]
v4.7.1.stable.official [a13da4feb]
v4.6.3.stable.official [7d41c59c4]

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev2 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - GeForce GTX 550 Ti - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-2100 CPU @ 3.10GHz (4 threads) - 11.95 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Copying the root node after saving and adding a child node, shows the error:
>  ERROR: scene/main/node.cpp:1879 - Index p_index = 0 is out of bounds ((int)data.children_cache.size() - data.internal_children_front_count_cache - data.internal_children_back_count_cache = 0).
>  ERROR: Child node disappeared while duplicating.
>  ERROR: scene/main/node.cpp:1879 - Index p_index = 0 is out of bounds ((int)data.children_cache.size() - data.internal_children_front_count_cache - data.internal_children_back_count_cache = 0).
>  ERROR: Child node disappeared while duplicating.

### Steps to reproduce

- create a new empty project
- add a root node: Node2D
- save the scene
- add a child node: Node2D
- right-click on the root node: Node2D
- choose: Copy

### Issue
The output panel shows:
>  ERROR: scene/main/node.cpp:1879 - Index p_index = 0 is out of bounds ((int)data.children_cache.size() - data.internal_children_front_count_cache - data.internal_children_back_count_cache = 0).
>  ERROR: Child node disappeared while duplicating.
>  ERROR: scene/main/node.cpp:1879 - Index p_index = 0 is out of bounds ((int)data.children_cache.size() - data.internal_children_front_count_cache - data.internal_children_back_count_cache = 0).
>  ERROR: Child node disappeared while duplicating.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/eff9301f-0513-4c98-841f-31cf4d3dc38a

### Expected
No error.

N/A
